turns.content: Show that if a sum above 2013 uses two palindromes, at least one summand must be a four-digit palindrome greater than 1006.
List the four-digit palindromes between 1007 and 2020 using full digit-reversal symmetry.
Using only the earlier size bound in place of the four-digit candidate list, produce the representations from 2014 through 2018.
Explain why establishing this consecutive representable block is enough to reduce the minimality question to testing 2019 next.
Test 2019 by subtracting the entries of the representation list rather than the four-digit-palindrome list.
Classify the representations, rather than the complements, as palindromes when deciding whether 2019 is representable.
Determine the least integer greater than 2013 that is not a sum of two palindromes.
